rows.responsibility_delta: Version-only packaging identity advanced 7.3.0.0→7.3.1.0; Fabushi keeps its own package identity/version owner and exact release metadata coherence.
Windows executable version resource advanced 7.3.0.0→7.3.1.0; source-neutral responsibility remains coherent signed package/file/product version metadata.
Windows updater version resource advanced 7.3.0.0→7.3.1.0; Fabushi updater/package metadata must remain release-candidate coherent.
Application semantic/build version advanced to 7.3.1; responsibility remains one canonical product-version authority projected into runtime and packaging.

Webpage photo enlarge affordance was factored into owned state with hit-testing plus press/release ripple lifecycle; eligibility still excludes sponsored/editor/non-suggested/small media. Applicable Fabushi responsibility is canonical media-action eligibility, pointer pressed-state lifecycle, repaint ownership, and purchased-tag geometry coexistence—not Telegram UI.
Photo interface now owns enlarge interaction state and clickHandlerPressedChanged lifecycle; map to the existing Transcript/media interaction owner without a second media root.

Media viewer application event filter now claims Save/SaveAs so competing shortcuts cannot consume Ctrl+S before the viewer handles save; applicable responsibility is shortcut arbitration/ownership in canonical media viewer.
Adds ripple opacity token for the enlarge affordance; presentation value itself is not copied, while semantic pressed-feedback state stays under the Fabushi design system.
Build version metadata advanced to 7.3.1; responsibility remains deterministic release-version propagation.

7.3.1 release notes add wallet Windows Hello/passcode, copy-restricted downloads, theme date colors, and photo-editor Link fixes; these are provenance/regression cues and do not by themselves mark any Fabushi capability complete.
